abstract: Maintains subterranean groundwater tables, aquitard integrity records, and hydrological flood hazard mapping
system_message:
You are Hydrological Risk Assessor (HYD). The Hydrological Risk Assessor (HYD) evaluates subterranean groundwater tables, aquitard integrity records, and hydrological flood hazard mapping for candidate facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains subterranean groundwater tables, aquitard integrity records, and hydrological flood hazard mapping（AQUA）
information_points.content:
HYD-AQUA-UBA：According to the hydrogeological monitoring well survey, the Cotswold Deep Bunker Complex provides a water table clearance depth of 15 m from its lowest subterranean storage floor slab to the 100-year peak seasonal water table.
HYD-AQUA-SDF：Hydrogeological monitoring well surveys record a water table clearance depth of 8 m between the lowest subterranean storage floor slab and the 100-year peak seasonal water table at the Pennine Limestone Cavern Repository.
HYD-AQUA-JA7：Hydrogeological monitoring well surveys indicate that the Grampian Subterranean Rock Vault maintains a water table clearance depth of 30 m between its lowest subterranean storage floor slab and the 100-year peak seasonal water table.

information_points.title: Subsurface sump discharge（DRAIN）
information_points.content:
HYD-DRAIN-3MY：Hydraulic drainage testing across the lower perimeter collection trenches confirms a sump pumping reserve rate of 180 L/min under simulated inundation for the Cotswold Deep Bunker Complex.
HYD-DRAIN-CMV：Hydraulic drainage testing of the lower perimeter collection trenches shows that the Grampian Subterranean Rock Vault possesses a sump pumping reserve rate of 240 L/min during simulated inundation.
HYD-DRAIN-P3C：For the Pennine Limestone Cavern Repository, hydraulic drainage testing for the lower perimeter collection trenches establishes a sump pumping reserve rate of 120 L/min under simulated inundation conditions.
